Bicycle: Individual bicycles tracked within bike-sharing systems, including their current location and availability
Bicyclestationbay: Individual docking bays at bicycle stations, showing whether each bay is occupied or free
BIKE_CHARGER_BAY: Individual bays at e-bike charging stations
BikeCounter: Automatic counters that record the number of cyclists passing a given point
BikeParking: Bicycle parking facilities with location and capacity information
BikeParkingBay: Individual parking bays within a bicycle parking facility
BikeSharingService: Bike-sharing service providers and their overall system information
BikesharingStation: Physical bike-sharing docking stations with real-time bike availability
BluetoothStation: Roadside sensors that detect Bluetooth signals from passing vehicles to measure traffic flow
CarpoolingHub: Meeting points/hubs where carpooling trips start or end
CarpoolingService: Carpooling service providers and their system information
CarpoolingUser: Registered users of a carpooling service
CarsharingCar: Individual vehicles belonging to a car-sharing fleet, with location and availability
CarSharingService: Car-sharing service providers and their overall system information
CarsharingStation: Fixed pick-up/drop-off stations used by car-sharing services
CompanyGamificationAction: Gamified mobility actions or challenges tracked at the company/organization level
CreativeIndustry: Locations or entities related to the creative industry sector
Culture: Cultural points of interest such as museums, theaters, or heritage sites
EChargingPlug: Individual charging plugs/connectors at an electric vehicle charging station, with real-time status (free/occupied)
EChargingStation: Electric vehicle charging stations, including location and availability
EnvironmentStation: Environmental monitoring stations measuring air quality and related parameters
Flight: Flight information for scheduled air traffic
GamificationAction: Individual gamified actions or achievements related to sustainable mobility
IndoorStation: Sensors or beacons used for indoor positioning and monitoring
LinkStation: Connections/links between mobility stations, representing routes or relationships between them
MeteoStation: Weather stations providing meteorological measurements such as temperature, precipitation, and wind
Mobilestation: Multimodal mobility hubs combining several transport options at one location
NOI-Place: Rooms, desks, or spaces within the NOI Techpark, including occupancy/booking information
ON_DEMAND_ITINERARY: Planned itineraries for on-demand transport services
ON_DEMAND_STOP: Stops served by on-demand (flexible) public transport services
ON_DEMAND_VEHICLE: Vehicles operating within on-demand transport services, with real-time position
ParkingFacility: Parking facilities (garages/lots) as physical structures, distinct from individual parking stations
ParkingSensor: Individual sensors that detect whether a single parking space is occupied
ParkingStation: Parking lots and garages with real-time occupancy data (free/occupied spaces)
PeopleCounter: Sensors that count the number of people passing a given location
RWISstation: Road Weather Information System stations measuring road surface and weather conditions relevant to traffic safety
ScooterSharingService: Scooter-sharing service providers and their overall system information
ScooterSharingStation: Fixed or virtual stations used by scooter-sharing services
Streetstation: Sensor stations installed along streets for traffic or environmental monitoring
TrafficDirection: Directional traffic flow measurements at a given location
TrafficForecast: Predicted future traffic conditions based on historical and real-time data
TrafficSensor: Traffic sensors measuring metrics such as vehicle counts and speed
TrafficStreetFactor: Factors describing traffic conditions on specific street segments (e.g. congestion levels)
VMS: Variable Message Signs (electronic road signs) displaying traffic information to drivers
WeatherForecast: Predicted weather conditions for specific locations
WebStatistics: Web analytics/usage statistics collected from digital platforms
WebStatstics: Web analytics/usage statistics (alternate/duplicate entry of WebStatistics)
